approval_record.user_instruction: 开始自动调用所有的skill以及必要的hook开始工作吧，并且请自行调用agents

objective: 从零实现PDM核心及P_ADO/P_DCO/PDCO响应；交付Notebook、即时四联图与delta/sigma-I的ETI/HDI、友好GUI、独立/实测验证、Python图文报告及multipolePDM PyPI包。
start_rule: 用户已批准且当前原生goal active；先恢复账本/worker，不重复创建goal。
detector_angle_input_unit: deg; one conversion at geometry boundary
release_strategy: one universal Python wheel plus sdist on PyPI; no mandatory native installers
environment_policy: global Python environment permitted; no task virtualenv
credential_policy: Read only in publish subprocess; production upload and metadata SHA/install readback passed; no token stored in outputs.
benchmark_exclusions: SHU74 (resolve source alias before admitting related cases)
case_identity: user-facing nuclide + transition energy; header-based import, no fixed rows/column positions

source_inputs.role: 只读研究数据，按表头/核素/能量识别

coverage_targets.policy: 先冻结选择；缺实测不能用合成替代；不按结果换样。

platform_policy: Docker offscreen/Xvfb is the GUI verification baseline; host GUI not required. Native OS experience remains explicitly unverified unless actually tested.
completion_rule: T00-T19有验收证据；PyPI真实制品上传及回读成功；案例目标缺口不冒称完成；平台和Git远端按计划范围如实记录。

terminology.R_DCO: DCO比（定向核的方向关联比） / DCO ratio

input_examples.batch_schema: top-level jobs array containing complete single-job objects

plot_standard.hdi: blue fill from zero to PDF within each HDI segment

dependency_policy: pyproject.toml is the single source; pip installs runtime requirements; optional analysis/dev extras; generated requirements only if needed; global environment allowed; agent handles normal downloads/install/debug.
user_assistance_boundary: Only personal account/API-key/remote authorization and genuinely external unavailable resources; not routine dependency installation or debugging.

required_invariants: same joint kernel for P and DCO
P_single sums intensities over full gate directions before ratio
DCO uses joint intensities with gate probabilities retained
target-second single P uses propagated state, not fresh Gaussian
U_k is not a gated-sigma correction
pure terms and mixed phases checked against original erratum

gui_validation.fallback: Xvfb/xvfb-run for real Qt rendering on a virtual X server
gui_validation.limits: Do not claim Windows/macOS native desktop or drivers tested; unsupported GUI items are explicitly unverified; do not block physics on host display access.

autonomous_research: Fill unspecified details using local evidence first, then archived legal external primary sources; record locators/assumptions/verification; do not silently change agreed core response definitions or add chi-square.

worker_policy.isolation: disjoint scratch artifact prefixes; parent integrates

git_remote_request: 已异步询问独立PDM远端URL；不阻塞计算与PyPI准备

do_not_repeat: Rebuild no physics from scratch: full amplitude and independent 9j kernels exist and passed tests
Do not rerun source screening or all synthetic tests unless validating a changed core/final release
Do not stage shared parallel literature-learning edits
continuation.known_repo_parallel_work: Existing learning task modifies knowledge/index, HDR/source pages, literature-acquisition queues, system/handoff/log. Leave those edits alone; keep PDM task state here.

actual_coverage.scope: Declared point and ideal-ring models of measured observations; no exact array replay

git_publication.scope: Wiki PDM task records and knowledge only; software source archive remains local and PyPI artifacts are public
git_publication.stable_pointer: main / research: deliver multipolePDM three-mode validation and release
git_publication.reconciliation: Release task-record commit verified against exact scope and pushed to origin/main; unrelated worktree changes retained.
